import sys

try:
    from pypdf import PdfReader
except ImportError:
    try:
        from PyPDF2 import PdfReader
    except ImportError:
        print("NO_PDF_LIB")
        sys.exit(0)

path = sys.argv[1]
r = PdfReader(path)
print("pages:", len(r.pages))
text = "".join((p.extract_text() or "") for p in r.pages)
for s in [
    "技术服务合同",
    "甲方（委托方）",
    "星河科技有限公司",
    "乙方（服务方）",
    "远见软件工作室",
    "甲方（盖章）",
    "乙方（盖章）",
    "日期：2026",
    "第一条",
    "第四条",
]:
    print(repr(s), s in text)
print("text_chars:", len(text))
